custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the toe area. Real socks usually have a visible seam or gathered stitch at the very tip. AI often generates a smooth, bulbous end. Also, inspect the cable knit pattern for logical continuity—do the cables cross consistently, or do they melt into each other? Check if the shadow under the foot matches the lighting direction implied by the highlights on the sock.
